import re, sys
from pathlib import Path
name, phrases = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2:]
text = Path("skills/%s/SKILL.md" % name).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
ref = Path("skills/%s/references/source.md" % name)
assert ref.is_file(), "missing references/source.md"
ref.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
assert "Drift checklist" in text, "drift checklist heading"
assert "issue_templates:" in text and "no ignored" in text.lower() or "Do **not**" in text and "issue_templates" in text, "config.yml rule"
assert "T0" in text and "T3" in text, "tier table in checklist"
assert "pipefail" in text, "pre-push pipefail"
m = re.match(r"---\n(.*?)\n---\n", text, re.S)
assert m, "missing frontmatter"
fm = m.group(1)
assert re.search(r"^name: %s$" % re.escape(name), fm, re.M), "frontmatter name"
for marker in ("**Purpose**", "**Trigger**", "Last updated: "):
    assert marker in text, marker
for p in phrases:
    assert p in text, "missing: " + p
print("OK: " + name)
